item: The first Library figures request no longer counts every keyword mention on the request thread; a stall record names only a statement that ran inside the request
summary: GET /api/database/figures took 55.6 s once because the cold served cache computed its whole-table keyword_mentions COUNT inline. The cold start now answers at once with the cheap figures and the count as computing (pending_since), runs ONE background count under a 300 s statement deadline, and records a failed count by kind, deadline and a 900 s retry window instead of retrying per poll; the tile says counting or not counted with the reason on hover, in 12 locales. Stall forensics now names a slow statement only if it ended inside the request and was not longer than it.
